payload.summary: Cold searches are disk-bound: index-units search took 9.2 s cold versus 0.19 s warm because the search tables are about nine times the database cache
payload.detail: Read-only live evidence 2026-10-21 (docs/audit/2026-10-21-database-performance-evidence.md): database 8.8 GB, search tables about 6.8 GB, shared_buffers 256 MB, effective_cache_size 768 MB. The term-overlap branch pulled 6,568 units (3,389 kept) for a three-word query, then fetched each embedding and search_tsv. OWNER DECISION: (a) larger Supabase compute size, paid, dashboard only, no code change; or (b) bound the term-overlap branch before ranking, a RAG behaviour change needing a live canary pair. Recommended (a) first, then re-capture the baseline twice (cold and warm).
